HEADERS.HERO-SUBTITLE: Track what you read, set goals, write reviews, and discover your next favorite book — all in one place.
HEADERS.ABOUT-FEATURES-TITLE: What you can do in StoryStack
HEADERS.ABOUT-WHY-1: Intuitive and beautiful design — reading management is a pleasure

PARAGRAPHS.ADVANTAGES-1: Stay motivated by tracking reading activity, progress, and current page count in real time
PARAGRAPHS.ADVANTAGES-2: Set your yearly reading goals and measure progress with clear stats and visual insights
PARAGRAPHS.ADVANTAGES-3: Add custom tags to organize books by genre, mood, difficulty, or any category fits your style
PARAGRAPHS.QA-FORM-DESC: We are always happy to hear from you! Leave your email and we will contact as soon as possible.
PARAGRAPHS.PRIVACY-POLICY: I accept the Terms of Use & Privacy Policy
PARAGRAPHS.ABOUT-SUBTITLE: StoryStack — your cozy space for books, where reading becomes a pleasant and conscious habit.
PARAGRAPHS.ABOUT-MISSION-DESC: StoryStack was created for you so that every reader could easily manage their library, track progress, set goals and receive personalized book recommendations powered by modern AI — without unnecessary complexity.
PARAGRAPHS.ABOUT-FEATURE-1: Add books manually or instantly via Google Books, assign statuses, rate, write notes, quotes and custom tags
PARAGRAPHS.ABOUT-FEATURE-2: Track goals, see statistics, use reading calendar, current book progress with pages left — everything to stay motivated.
PARAGRAPHS.ABOUT-FEATURE-3: Smart recommendations based on your tastes, ratings and tags — the AI helps discover exactly those books that you are likely to love.
PARAGRAPHS.ABOUT-FEATURE-4: Detailed reviews, favorite quotes, personal impressions — your library becomes truly yours.
PARAGRAPHS.ABOUT-WHY-DESC: StoryStack combines powerful functionality with a clean, modern interface and cares about your reading experience.
PARAGRAPHS.ABOUT-WHY-1: Intuitive and beautiful design — reading management is a pleasure
PARAGRAPHS.ABOUT-WHY-2: Complete privacy — your books, notes and ratings only for you (or friends, if you want)
PARAGRAPHS.ABOUT-WHY-3: Constant updates — new features, better recommendations, integrations
